ptr.note: The frame, borrowed: when any buffer is shared or read-only C allocates a frame of its geometry (av_frame_get_buffer, or av_hwframe_get_buffer for hw frames), av_frame_copy's the planes (reads through the frame's untrusted geometry), av_frame_copy_props's (side data memcpy), unrefs the frame and moves the copy in (uninitialised padding). A failing get_buffer returns without freeing the copied ch_layout (leaks a CUSTOM map). Rust: FrameMut::make_writable composes the same C steps over zeroed buffers. Its av_frame_get_buffer(&tmp, 0) overflows int for audio of INT_MAX - 31 samples (av_samples_get_buffer_size's FFALIGN rounding); Rust's copy hands C the line size it would round to.
